releaseNotesKm: ផ្ទាំងដើមថ្មីទាំងស្រុង។ កាលវិភាគថ្ងៃនេះជាខ្សែពេលវេលា មានចំណុចម៉ោងបច្ចុប្បន្ន។ មានម៉ោងរស់នៅ ស្ថានភាពការងារ និងកិច្ចការសំខាន់។
releaseNotesEn: The Home tab is rebuilt as a command centre. The toolbar is replaced by a live status strip, today is set as a headline, and today's events are drawn as a timeline with your working day on the same line and a marker at the current minute. Adds a next/progress pair, a numbered focus list, an up-next strip and a quick-action dock in place of the floating button.
